name: HFbioVR Immersive
summary:
HFbioVR Immersive is the immersive component of HFbioVR.

It runs the rehabilitation and cognitive exercises of the HFbioVR system,
used by physiotherapy practices, rehabilitation centres and health
professionals.

It is not used on its own. The HFbioVR app handles sign-in, the patient
dashboard and the exercise catalogue; when an exercise is started, it
opens here in virtual reality.

Requires:
• HFbioVR installed on the same headset
• an account issued by the clinic adopting HFbioVR
• a network connection
